searches.reason: Explore jointly learned item representations from permitted titles and descriptions to capture specific product fit beyond item identity. Favor lightweight text encoders trained from scratch inside one NextItNet model, with no pretrained weights or separate semantic scorer. Text can supply observable distinctions, while ownership and current intent remain unobserved.
